Subject: Requesting trial credits for PLG signup (OrchidAI)

Hi Ben,

We just signed up for a self-serve account (org: OrchidAI) and have been exploring the Playground and embeddings flow. We're doing a short pilot to evaluate if Redwood fits our latency and cost targets for a summarization product.

Quick details:
- Use case: multi-doc summarization + reranking for enterprise docs
- Expected monthly tokens during pilot: ~1.2M tokens (generation + context)
- Key metric: avg lat < 350ms, cost < $0.0008 per gen-token

Could we get a small credit grant or promo to run a couple of end-to-end tests? I've attached our intake form (trial_request_form.pdf) and a screenshot of the test harness. If you need a HubSpot/Acct id, let me know.

Thanks — happy to hop on a 20-min call if that helps.

Best,
Ari Gold

Thanks for the details, Ari — welcome and congrats on the signup. A few quick clarifying Qs so we can triage this properly: 

1) Can you paste the Redwood org id or HubSpot link for the account? That lets us check past usage and avoid duplicate grants.
2) Are the 1.2M tokens peak/month or average? Any expected spikes (batch ingest runs)?
3) Any regulatory restrictions (data residency, retention) we should flag?

I looped in Priyom from Growth so he can help with the fulfillment. I've attached a short credit policy summary for internal reference. If you prefer, we can fast-track a small grant while you provide the account id.

Next steps: please reply with the HubSpot link or confirmation of org id, and I’ll route to fulfillment.

—Ben
